name: opencode-style
description: OpenCode-style layout for Claude Code: barred prompts, icon tool rows, a session sidebar and plain spinner words, in Claude Code's own colours

autoOpenSidebar.title: Open the sidebar automatically
autoOpenSidebar.description: Dock the session sidebar when the fullscreen layout starts. /sidebar shows or hides it either way.

sessionTitles.title: Name sessions with Haiku
sessionTitles.description: Title the sidebar with a short name Haiku writes from your first message: one small request per session. Off, the first line of the message is the title.

showEmail.title: Show the account email in the sidebar
showEmail.description: Off by default, so a shared or recorded screen doesn't show it.

expandToolGroups.title: List every tool call on its own row
expandToolGroups.description: Off, runs of reads and searches stay folded into Claude Code's one-line summary.

restyleMessages.title: Restyle your messages and Claude's replies
restyleMessages.description: Your messages on a panel behind a coloured bar; replies indented without the bullet.

restyleToolRows.title: Draw tool calls as one-line rows
restyleToolRows.description: OpenCode-style rows such as `→ Read src/index.ts` and `$ npm test`.

turnFooter.title: End each reply with the Built footer
turnFooter.description: `▣ Built · model · 3.2s` in place of Claude Code's `Baked for 3s` line.

plainSpinner.title: Plain spinner words
plainSpinner.description: Thinking, Writing, Running and Preparing in place of the whimsical words.

asciiIcons.title: ASCII icons
asciiIcons.description: Plain characters in place of symbols such as ▣ ✱ ◈ ◉, for fonts that lack them.
